title: roots of a quadratic equation
author: 66b13dde02450b0e64029946
chapter_outcomes: Sum of roots and product of roots of a quadratic equation.
For the equation ax2 + bx + c = 0, whose roots are α and β, then α + β = −b/a, αβ = c/a.
Manipulation of expressions involving the sum of roots and product of roots.
Knowledge of the identity α3 + β3 ≡ (α + β)3 − 3αβ(α + β).
Forming quadratic equations with new roots. For example, with roots α3, β3; 1/α, 1/β; 2/1α, 2/1β; α + 2/β, β + 2/α; etc.
